what: Every event CivicClerk lists under category General, 2024-01-18 to 2027-01-19, as the API returned it
how: collector.fetch.PoliteFetcher (robots.txt checked first, 10 s between requests, GET only), following @odata.nextLink on the API host

fields.date: startDateTime, first ten characters as printed (civicclerk.parse_events)
fields.asked: the name contains one of also_list name_words (case-insensitive), so discovery asks for it
fields.pattern_page1: the page-1 heading of the first configured event pattern that matches the whole name (civicclerk.also_pattern), else null: not listed
fields.files: publishedFiles: type, name, publishOn date, fileId
